walkTest.title: Walk test
walkTest.instructions: Mark arrival immediately, wait 30 seconds, then depart.
walkTest.notesPlaceholder: Phone, OS/browser, Wi-Fi, permissions, battery saver, route

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.help: Use three non-collinear fit landmarks and a fourth independent check. Match drawing coordinates to public-map landmarks, never to the test walk. Alignment and checkpoint positions remain approximate; the app does not detect your floor.
calibration.uncertainty: The blue area describes the phone's reported accuracy only. Manual correction adds unvalidated uncertainty.
calibration.residuals: Fit residuals: {fit} m. Check residual: {check} m. These do not verify geographic accuracy.
